topic.title: What Do You Think the Maximum Achievable Score Will Be?
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content: Hey guys i hope ur doing well , What do you think the maximum achievable scorewill be in this competition? I’m curious what people think the practical ceiling for the leaderboard might be

comments.content: My analytical estimate is around 0.76,with a more realistic maximum probably around 0.55

replies.content: Congratulations on topping the leaderboard! Can I ask how you came up with your analytical estimate? Did you break it down by class?
Thank you. I broke it down by class and did some extrapolations from my model's accuracies.

comments.content: I'd be interested in a breakdown of candidate coverage versus ranking accuracy. On a held-out set, how often is the correct structure in the candidate list, and how often does it get ranked first? That seems like a useful starting point for estimating the ceiling. Has anyone checked those two numbers for their retrieval baseline?
